# System mode accent rule

The moving top-edge rail on Recent Project cards is a **system-mode indicator**, not just decoration.

Current mapping:

- **Fire** — red to orange gradient
- **Intruder** — dark blue (future)
- **CCTV** — light blue / cyan (future)
- **Access Control** — green (future)

When the other system modes are enabled, keep the same rail geometry, timing and movement and only swap the colour family to the active system mode. This keeps the Home screen visually consistent while making the animation useful at a glance.
